text:
alex.m: Quick heads-up — saw ~12% regression in p50 prefill latency on gpu-pool-3 after rolling the new kernel-selector heuristics (opt-level=B). Attached flame graph in the gist link below.

cheng: Ack. Is this specific to long-context requests or overall?

alex.m: Mostly 1k-2k token prefill windows. Decode path looks fine. Prefill seems to be doing weird kernel choices that stall on matmul-launch.

maria: Can you paste the lightweight profile output? Prefer short snippets so we don't dig through the full flame.

alex.m: Sure — from perf-lite on one repro:

```
prefill_phase: kernel_select#choose_kernel_v2 54.3%
  3x matmul_launch (cuda_sync) 31.8%
  attention_split_prepare 12.2%
decode_phase: choose_kernel_v1 9.1%
other: kv_warmup 2.4%
```

kai: Interesting that choose_kernel_v2 is dominant only during prefill. Might be our sequence-length heuristic misclassifying prefill batches as "short" and picking fast but narrow kernels.

alex.m: I also dumped batch composition for the window: lots of mixed prompt lengths, batched aggressively, which probably triggered a compact-kernel choice.

cheng: Proposal: split batch formation policy into two logical queues — prefill-queue and decode-queue — each with separate kernel hints and token-budget targets. Keep the existing continuous batcher but tag requests with phase and route at the queue boundary.

maria: +1. We should also add a small hysteresis on kernel selection for prefill: don't switch to compact kernels unless sustained for N batches or until KV-drain < X. That reduces flip-flop.

alex.m: Agreed. Quick experiment plan:
1) Add phase tag at enqueue.
2) Create prefill queue with token_budget_target=4096 and prefer kernels labeled "wide-matmul".
3) Decode queue token_budget_target=1024, prefer streaming-friendly kernels.
4) Add kernel-hysteresis window=3.

Example config snippet:
```
batcher:
  queues:
    - name: prefill
      token_budget_target: 4096
      kernel_preference: [wide-matmul, fallback]
      hysteresis_batches: 3
    - name: decode
      token_budget_target: 1024
      kernel_preference: [stream-small, fallback]
```

kai: Can we do this as a runtime toggle with no restart? If we can flip a flag and start routing, we can measure before/after quickly.

alex.m: Yes — routing lives in the batcher coordinator; push a remote config that sets queue mapping by phase. No restart. I'll draft the flag.

maria: Also capture these metrics for the experiment: p50/p95 prefill latency, matmul_launch stalls, kernel-flip-rate (kernels switched per N batches), kv-warmup-hit-rate. Add a short-lived alert if p95 spikes > 2x baseline.

cheng: One more thought — KV-cache priming: prefill-heavy workloads suffer when KV caches are cold and then kernel choice causes more memcpy. Add an adaptive kv-warmup budget: warm first few KV pages for flows that hit a wide-kernel preference. Something like: if prefill and batch_size>1 then kv_warmup_budget=128KB.

alex.m: Nice. I'll add a simple warmup increment and measure memory copies.

tj-bot: deploy requested by alex.m for branch "phase-queue-prefill". CI passed. Rolling to canary (gpu-pool-3) 10% -> 50% -> 100%. :rocket:

kai: After canary step1 (10%) we saw p50 prefill drop 8% and p95 stable. matmul_launch stall metric down 22%.

maria: Good signal. Any regression on decode latency?

alex.m: No meaningful change on decode. Kernel-flip-rate for prefill dropped from 0.42->0.08 flips/batch.

cheng: Great. Let's keep canary and monitor 1h. If stable, promote. Also capture a short note for release that this is a scheduling and kernel-hint change — not model binary.

alex.m: Will write a quick internal blurb and add the config defaults to the docs under batcher heuristics.

maria: Postmortem-ish note: the root cause was overly eager kernel selector not considering KV-copy cost for dense prefill matrix shapes. Splitting queues + hysteresis fixed most pathologies.

alex.m: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: (1) add kv warmup budget experiment, (2) run 48-hour smoke on high-concurrency synth load, (3) land docs.

kai: LGTY. :thumbsup:

tj-bot: deploy complete to gpu-pool-3 at 2597654380.
